For  Rider of the Apocalypse in Mythic+, this build plays almost exactly like Unholy normally does in Single Target scenarios. The only major difference is swapping to pressing Epidemic instead of Death Coil. This build mostly focuses on buffing our Magus' as much as possible, and summoning as many as possible to deal most of our sustained AoE damage.
